_schema.purpose: Optional hand-written technical detail for selected projects. Keyed by exact GitHub repository name. Anything omitted simply is not shown — the project detail page never invents content.

fields.objective: What the project was required to achieve.
fields.implementation: How it was built: hardware, software, tooling.
fields.results: Measured or observed outcomes. State only what was actually observed.
fields.documentation: URL to further documentation, if any.
